posts.title: Ultimate Home Server Part 1: Proxmox, ZFS Pools, and Samba Shares
posts.description: Build the foundation of a Proxmox home server: install Proxmox VE, create mirrored and RAIDZ ZFS pools, set up an Ubuntu LXC with storage mount points, and share it across your network with Samba.

posts.title: Ultimate Home Server Part 2: A Jellyfin Media Server VM on Proxmox
posts.description: Create an Ubuntu Server VM on Proxmox, pass through Intel Quick Sync, mount the Samba data share, and run Jellyfin with Docker Compose and hardware transcoding.

posts.title: Ultimate Home Server Part 3: The Automated *arr Stack
posts.description: Deploy my Docker Compose media automation stack with Gluetun, qBittorrent, NZBGet, Prowlarr, Sonarr, Radarr, Bazarr, and Seerr, all wired together on static IPs and feeding Jellyfin.
